allowed_use: One bounded public national Hospital General Information distribution acquired by the standalone application, with reuse notice proof and stable public metadata.
notice_limit: General government-work reuse notice, not proof that third-party rights or dataset-specific agreements are absent. Reject access or source-contract drift.
source_lease: Exclusive cross-process lifecycle lease; unresolved network ownership or cleanup failure requires inspection, no automatic takeover or retry.
retention: Immutable operation-owned source/notice bytes on success. Failure retains completed source bytes internally with hashes, intent and fixed failure evidence; only owned partial/derived unpublished outputs are removed. No automated retry.
